title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - LeiCode
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/LeiCode. Legal Entity Identifier registration number. Subclass of RegistrationNumber per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the RegistrationNumber model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LeiCode'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

leiCode.description: Property. Unique LEI number as defined by https://www.gleif.org.

countryCode.description: Property. The country where the LEI number is registered (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or equivalent).

subdivisionCountryCode.description: Property. The country subdivision (state/region) where the LEI number is registered. Controlled-vocabulary value (RegionCode), enumeration not resolved in this pass.
